instructions: Give a direct answer rather than describing a research process.
Never present an option as accessible without explicit supporting evidence.

criteria.description: Each recommended experience must be supported by explicit, current evidence that it meets the stated accessibility requirement. A recommendation presented as accessible without such evidence is a violation.
criteria.title: Every recommendation has explicit accessibility evidence

criteria.description: The answer should provide the requested number of qualifying recommendations, or clearly explain why fewer qualified.
criteria.title: Provides the requested number of recommendations

criteria.description: Operator or authority pages are suitable evidence for accessibility; user reviews alone are not sufficient for access claims.
criteria.title: Accessibility claims cite suitable sources

criteria.description: Where the requirement makes arrival practicalities important, the answer should address them rather than only naming venues.
criteria.title: Practical arrival and entry details are addressed

criteria.description: The answer should distinguish confirmed accessibility from claims that need direct confirmation with the operator.
criteria.title: Unverifiable accessibility is flagged

access_need.description: accessible parking or drop-off within a short, level distance of the entrance

prompt:
A visitor to Adelaide, SA, needs
accessible parking or drop-off within a short, level distance of the entrance. They are interested in wildlife and nature.

Recommend 3 experiences within approximately
30 km that meet this requirement. For every
recommendation, the accessibility claim must rest on explicit, current
evidence such as the operator's own accessibility information — do not
assume access from general descriptions. If evidence for a promising option
cannot be found, say so rather than presenting it as accessible.

Include practical arrival details (parking or transport, entry) where the
requirement makes them important, cite sources close to the claims they
support, and flag anything that should be confirmed directly with the
operator.
